Research Task: Classification of low-grade astrocytoma, ependymoma, and medulloblastoma
Model: Two deep learning models; includes a vision transformer
Fusion Method: Joint fusion of image and age data
Main Findings: Best reported result: ADC with age fusion, accuracy 0.87 ± 0.08 and MCC 0.77 ± 0.14; age fusion marginally improved performance
Limitations: Limitations require review of the full paper
Relevance to PediVision: Directly relevant to pediatric brain tumor classification and MRI-plus-age fusion
